## RunDestinationResourceClient.get() method

Read the run destination identified by `name` within `workspaceName`<!-- -->. When several run destinations share the same name, the first match in the app's order is used, and the operation does not fail as ambiguous. When several workspace documents share the same name, the first match in the app's order is used as the workspace document.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get(workspaceName: string, name: string, options?: CallOptions): Promise<RunDestination>;
```
